case.name: Employee Policy Q&A
case.business_problem: Help employees find answers in internal HR/IT policy documents without searching a wiki.
case.desired_outcome: Fast, grounded answers citing the relevant policy section, reducing HR ticket volume for routine questions.
case.quality_target: High groundedness; every answer must cite the source policy section
case.cost_constraint: Low - internal tool, modest query volume
case.regulatory_constraints: No PII beyond the asking employee's own identity, used only to scope visible policies
case.roi_notes: Illustrative assumptions, not measurements: Efficiency: deflects an estimated 30% of routine HR/IT policy questions from a human queue. Solution cost: embeddings plus a small hosted model, well under the ceiling.

tradeoff_notes: The task is always "find and explain a policy section" - there's no branching logic or tool choice to orchestrate, so a single augmented call with RAG retrieval is the smallest sufficient pattern. A topic-routing workflow adds orchestration with no quality benefit here, and an agent adds latency/cost for a one-shot lookup that doesn't need runtime tool selection.
